body.content: {"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"msg_alert_001\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\", \"user_id\": \"U001\", \"ts\": \"1771146000.000001\"}\nHey team, we had a no-show today. The invitee was jennifer.martinez@crestview.example.com - can someone follow up?"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"msg_policy_001\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\", \"user_id\": \"U001\", \"ts\": \"1770072000.000001\"}\nNo-Show Follow-Up Procedure: Create task with subject 'Follow up on missed call - <EventName>'. Set priority to High if any open opportunity on the account is >= $50,000, otherwise Normal. Include the scheduled time and total account pipeline value in the description."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"msg_old_policy\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\", \"user_id\": \"U001\", \"ts\": \"1769072000.000001\"}\nOld no-show procedure: Create task, set priority High only if pipeline >= $100,000. Normal otherwise."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"msg_alert_002\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\", \"user_id\": \"U001\", \"ts\": \"1771145900.000001\"}\nDeal closed! jennifer.martinez@crestview.example.com signed the contract."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990028.000028\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_28\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nUpland Systems ghosted for 3 weeks. Sent breakup email. Sometimes that works 😅"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990018.000018\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_18\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nFoxridge Capital: verbal yes from the CFO. Contract coming this week!"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990041.000041\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_41\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nWavecrest Analytics asking for a case study. Does anyone have an analytics vertical reference?"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990008.000008\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_08\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nCascade Analytics came back from procurement — they're asking for net-60 terms"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990003.000003\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_03\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nReminder: pipeline review call at 3pm today. Please update your opps before then."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990012.000012\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_12\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nCloudBridge Systems is requesting a technical deep-dive on security architecture. Need an SE for March 8"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990025.000025\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_25\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nStonebridge Holdings legal review complete — moving to final approval. Should close by Friday."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990017.000017\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_17\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nClearwater Systems legal is asking about SOC 2 Type II — grabbing report from InfoSec"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990026.000026\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_26\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nSunstone Capital: new CFO coming in. Scheduling intro call for next week."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990046.000046\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_46\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nBig W: Bayside Analytics just signed! $85k ARR, 18-month deal. Congrats team! 🥳"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990029.000029\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_29\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nWavecrest Analytics on boarding call went great. Happy customer — ask for referral?"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990014.000014\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_14\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nGood news: Alpine Digital signed! 2-year deal, $110k ARR. Nicely done Kevin!"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990045.000045\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_45\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nIronridge is back! After 6 weeks dark they replied to the breakup email. Scheduling a call."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990021.000021\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_21\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nOOO: I'm out Thursday-Friday. Northstar Media is covered by Jordan if anything urgent comes up."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990019.000019\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_19\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nHighpoint Consulting wants a custom integration quote. Looping in Solutions team."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990030.000030\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_30\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nZenith Platforms contract fully executed ✅ Handing off to CS now."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990044.000044\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_44\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nOOO Wed-Thu for QBR prep. All my accounts covered — ping me if urgent."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990002.000002\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_02\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nJust wrapped the Ironclad demo. Really engaged team, feels like a solid Proposal push."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990009.000009\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_09\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nNew competitive intel doc posted in #competitive. Ironridge is offering 20% discount to steal accounts."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990034.000034\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_34\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nReminder: all deals >$50k need second-level approval. Submit in Salesforce before EOD."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990031.000031\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_31\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nJust got off a call with Harbourview — they want to move to contract this week. Need legal ASAP."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990027.000027\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_27\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nTerrace Software asked for implementation timeline — sending over SOW template today"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990001.000001\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_01\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nMorning all! Big week ahead — let's close Q1 strong 💪"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990006.000006\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_06\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nBlueStar Ventures just signed the NDA — moving to discovery this week"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990050.000050\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_50\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nMaplecrest Systems sent us an unsolicited security questionnaire — anyone know this account?"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990004.000004\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_04\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nCongrats to Megan on closing Thornwood Partners! 🎉 $95k ARR"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990011.000011\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_11\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nWho owns the Silverstone Group account? Need to coordinate on renewal timing."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990023.000023\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_23\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nParkside Solutions: renewal conversation starting. They want a multi-year discount."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990037.000037\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_37\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nUpdated security questionnaire template posted in Google Drive. Check #sales-enablement."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990015.000015\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_15\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nWeek 9 leaderboard just posted. Three of us are over 130% — great work everyone!"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990013.000013\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_13\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nHarbourview Capital: champion just left the company 😬 Need to re-map the account"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990020.000020\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_20\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nMeadowbrook Tech delayed decision to Q2 — board didn't approve new software spend this quarter"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990048.000048\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_48\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nMeadowbrook Tech rescheduled again — Q2 for sure. Marking as delayed in CRM."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990039.000039\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_39\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nQ1 close plan: 5 deals in final stage, $620k at risk. Let's align on blockers today."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990033.000033\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_33\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nSunstone Capital agreed to a 2-year deal at 8% discount. Checking with VP before countersigning."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990049.000049\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_49\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nWeek 10 starts Monday. Let's sprint to close! Who needs backup on any deals?"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990038.000038\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_38\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nAnyone have a warm contact at Northstar Media? Need an intro for the media vertical."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990010.000010\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_10\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nStandup: Yesterday - Vertex Capital call. Today - Northgate demo. Blocker: legal review taking 2 weeks"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990047.000047\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_47\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nCloudBridge legal has questions about data residency. Looping in our DPO for a joint call."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990040.000040\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_40\", \"channel_id\": \"C_SALES_ALERTS\"}\nNew pricing deck is live — v3.2. All previous versions deprecated, please update your decks."}
